rationale: John brings deep cloud infrastructure and AI/ML ops expertise (AWS, GCP, Azure) paired with a conviction that agentic AI requires robust cloud-native foundations, while JD combines smart contract development and a sharp eye for spotting builders shipping real products over hype. Their complementary technical skills—John's systems-level backend focus and JD's full-stack web3 chops—could spark interesting conversations about infrastructure for emerging AI+web3 applications, and both share a no-nonsense ethos about substance over clout.
intro_message: John Komarnicki, meet JD — you both build infrastructure (John on cloud/AI ops, JD on smart contracts) and call out mediocrity in your respective spaces; worth a conversation about where those worlds might intersect.
